items.title: Offshore wells: Minister assures no harm to fishers, sea
items.desc: Tamil Nadu minister V K Rajiv says govt will protect fishermen’s livelihood and marine ecology while reviewing HOECL’s plan for four offshore wells near Parangipettai.

items.title: Gujarat University recognises Inflibnet as research centre for PhD programmes
items.desc: Gujarat University recognises INFLIBNET as a PhD research centre; MoU enables full/part-time PhDs in LIS and CS/IT with INFLIBNET scientists as guides.

items.title: Overcast sky persists but rain remains elusive for Ahmedabad, Gujarat
items.desc: Cloudy weather persists in Ahmedabad and across Gujarat as IMD predicts slim chances of major rain; light showers in a few south Gujarat talukas.

items.title: Bank manager held for forging collector’s signature
items.desc: Suryapet bank manager arrested for allegedly forging District Collector Tejas Nandlal Pawar’s signature on DMFT account documents; case filed under BNS sections.

items.title: Snail’s pace: Over half of CMRL Phase II complete, ballastless track laying at 67km
items.desc: Chennai Metro Phase-2: 54.62% complete, but ballast-less track laid only 67km across corridors; first 14.64km Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani stretch awaits launch.

items.title: Rs 82,400 drained from 64-year-old shopkeeper’s account during automatic phone update in Ahmedabad
items.desc: 64-year-old Ahmedabad shopkeeper loses Rs 82,400 in Google Pay fraud during an automatic mobile update; Sarkhej police probe transaction trail and beneficiary account.

items.title: iPhones worth Rs 11 lakh stolen from parcel on luxury bus going from Pune to Ahmedabad
items.desc: Ramol police in Ahmedabad filed a case after 14 iPhones worth Rs 10.71 lakh were stolen from a Pune-Ahmedabad parcel during the July 15-16 journey.

items.title: KBR Park one-way pilot hits teething troubles, commuters face long delays, diversions
items.desc: Hyderabad’s new one-way loop around KBR Park began at 6am, causing longer routes, lane confusion and delays; police plan better signage as commuters adjust.

items.title: Tahsildar circular seeking CPI, CPM members’ details stirs row
items.desc: Gujiliamparai tahsildar’s circular seeking names and addresses of CPI, CPI(M) members in Dindigul sparks Left parties’ protest and MP’s questions.

items.desc: Frank Lloyd Wright’s only Tennessee home, the historic Shavin House in Chattanooga, has sold at auction for $4 million after remaining with the same family for 74 years. Completed in 1952, the 1,784-square-foot Usonian home was listed for $1.6 million. The pr…

items.title: Family feud turns fatal, man killed by son-in-law’s father
items.desc: Illegal affair and family dispute led to P. Venkanna’s murder near Rampur Lake, Kazipet; police say the accused slit his throat after drinking.

items.title: H-FAST raids 130 units, seizes 25 tonnes of adulterated ghee in city-wide crackdown
items.desc: Hyderabad H-FAST raids 130 outlets, seizes 36 tonnes of adulterated ghee; lab tests found 19 of 21 samples tainted, cases to be filed under BNS.

items.title: Three gamblers drown in well following false police raid alarm
items.desc: Three men died in Bhavnagar after panic from a false police raid alarm during a late-night gambling session led them to fall into an uncovered well.

items.title: Migrant worker burnt alive as fire engulfs furniture warehouse in Sircilla
items.desc: Massive fire guts Mahalakshmi Furniture warehouse in Sircilla; UP migrant worker Mohammed Islam, 20, dies, Rs 50 lakh loss; short circuit suspected.

items.title: Migration churn hits IT hub hard: Serilingampally tops state in unmapped voters
items.desc: Hyderabad IT belt seats Serilingampally and Rajendranagar see 41% voters flagged ASDD in SIR, with 45% digitised electors unmapped amid high migration.

items.title: Who decides what works? Inside VA’s mental health treatment playbook
items.desc: Why can’t veterans always get FDA-approved treatments through VA? VA's Dr Wiecher explains how evidence, safety, guidelines and resources shape VA care.

items.title: Smriti Irani’s elevation rekindles buzz over BJP’s Amethi-Rae-Bareli mission
items.desc: Smriti Irani’s elevation as BJP national general secretary revives focus on Amethi-Rae Bareli strategy, with buzz of UP return and Rajya Sabha bid.

items.title: Pilgrim safety: Drones to keep track of lions on Shatrunjaya hill in Gujarat
items.desc: Gujarat plans 24/7 drone surveillance and watchtowers on Palitana’s Shatrunjaya hill as Asiatic lion sightings rise; pilgrims advised to travel dawn to dusk.

items.title: Police expect KBR Park one-way traffic flow to improve in a few days
items.desc: Hyderabad police say new one-way traffic around KBR Park caused peak-hour congestion due to road design and low awareness; 500 staff and drones deployed.

items.title: West Ham fans under fire over Manor Solomon chant that references Israeli winger 'hating Palestine'
items.desc: The Hammers completed the signing of the Israeli international from Tottenham for a £5million fee last week, and he made his debut against Burnley on Sunday.
